message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: selling counterfeit goods (UGG shoes, insoles) with known false trademark, quantity large. This is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪" (counterfeiting trademark) or "假冒注册商标的商品罪" which under Chinese criminal law is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪" (Trademark infringement). In examples, they used "侵犯著作权" for piracy, "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" etc. For counterfeit goods, typical label: "侵犯注册商标专用权". Could also be "销售假冒注册商标商品罪". The Chinese criminal law article 210 (now 212?) deals with "侵犯注册商标专用权罪". So answer likely "侵犯注册商标专用权". Also maybe "销售假冒注册商标商品" is same. In examples they used "侵犯著作权" for piracy. So we output that.

Thus final answer: [罪名]侵犯注册商标专用权<eoa>
